            connected_component = bfs(g, i, explored)
            connected_components.append(connected_component)

    q = deque([])
    connected_component = []
    q.append(node)
    explored.add(node)
    connected_component.append(node)
    while q:
        node = q.popleft()
        for adj_node in g[node]:
            if adj_node not in explored:
